steps.label: cleanAndShoot
steps.js: (function(){ try { var e=window.__experience; var cam=e.engine.camera.instance; var sc=e.scene||(e.engine&&e.engine.scene); var wu=window.__labWuMesh; var V3=cam.position.constructor; var wp=new V3(); var hidden=[]; var wuScreen=null; if(wu){ var p=wu.position.clone(); p.project(cam); wuScreen=[(p.x*0.5+0.5)*1280,(-p.y*0.5+0.5)*720]; } sc.traverse(function(o){ if(!o.isMesh||!o.visible) return; var n=o.name||''; if(n==='__lab_wu_carpet__'||n==='__lab_wu_ground__'||n==='__lab_aurora__') return; if(n.indexOf('Grass_chunk')===0) return; if(n==='AnimeSky') return; if(n.indexOf('main-waterfall')>=0||n.indexOf('west-waterfall')>=0||n.indexOf('east-waterfall')>=0||n.indexOf('south-waterfall')>=0) return; if(n.indexOf('tree-trunk')>=0||n.indexOf('top-island')>=0) return; if(n.indexOf('Butterfly')>=0) return; o.getWorldPosition(wp); var pp=wp.clone(); pp.project(cam); var sx=(pp.x*0.5+0.5)*1280, sy=(-pp.y*0.5+0.5)*720; var nearWu=false; if(wuScreen){ var ddx=sx-wuScreen[0], ddy=sy-wuScreen[1]; if(ddx*ddx+ddy*ddy < 220*220) nearWu=true; } var rightLow = sx>820 && sy>320; if(nearWu || rightLow){ o.visible=false; hidden.push(n.slice(0,24)); } }); if(window.__labAurora) window.__labAurora.visible=false; if(e.revealMesh) e.revealMesh.visible=false; var r=e.engine.renderer.instance; r.render(sc,cam); return JSON.stringify({hidden:hidden, wuScreen:wuScreen}); } catch(err){ return String(err); } })()

steps.label: hideMainIsland
steps.js: (function(){ try { var e=window.__experience; var sc=e.scene||(e.engine&&e.engine.scene); var hid=[]; sc.traverse(function(o){ if(o.isMesh && (o.name==='main-island'||o.name==='foliage-occlusion'||o.name==='basalt-main-old'||o.name==='basalt-top-old')){ o.visible=false; hid.push(o.name); } }); var r=e.engine.renderer.instance; var cam=e.engine.camera.instance; r.render(sc,cam); return JSON.stringify(hid); } catch(err){ return String(err); } })()
